genesisFriend.name: Genesis Friend
genesisFriend.description: A Genesis Rare Friend stocked inside a player-created prize machine. The winner keeps the Friend, or cashes out the USDG backing the creator attached to it.

generationsFriend.name: Generations Friend
generationsFriend.description: A Generations Rare Friend stocked inside a player-created prize machine. The winner keeps the Friend, or cashes out the USDG backing the creator attached to it.

createMachine.label: Open a prize machine
createMachine.description: Stock a new machine with Rare Friends and USDG prizes, set its pull price and its finite ticket deck, and put it on the arcade floor. The creator receives 95% of every pull.

pull.label: Pull the lever
pull.description: One ticket from the selected machine's finite deck. Win a stocked Rare Friend, a USDG prize, or nothing. The platform keeps 5% of the pull.

claimBacking.label: Take the backing
claimBacking.description: Burn a Friend won from a machine and take the USDG its creator attached to it. Keeping the Friend is always the other choice.

withdrawMachine.label: Collect creator receipts
withdrawMachine.description: Move the 95% creator share of every pull made on one of your machines into your wallet.

pauseMachine.label: Pause machine
pauseMachine.description: Take one of your machines off the floor without emptying it. Resume it whenever you like.

resumeMachine.label: Resume machine
resumeMachine.description: Put a paused machine back on the floor.

cancelMachine.label: Cancel machine
cancelMachine.description: Before its first pull, empty a machine: the USDG prize pool and backing are refunded and its Rare Friends return to your Friend wallet.
